entries.en: The process of converting $PLANET|$ with a Terraformation Nucleus has been aborted.

entries.zh: §H有人尝试与我们建立通讯。§!\n\n§H我们听到了远处湍急的流水、小型飞禽发出呱噪的叫声又扑棱扑棱地飞走。这份通讯似乎来自一个非常繁茂的生物群系。§!
entries.en: §HSomeone is trying to establish contact with us.§!\n\n§HWe hear the rush of flowing liquid in the distance, and the squawking and wing-flapping of tiny avians taking flight. The transmission seems to be coming from a thriving biome.§!

entries.zh: §H又有人尝试联络我们。§!\n\n§H我们又一次听到了之前生物群系的声音。但还是没有任何人出现。§!
entries.en: §HSomeone is attempting to contact us again.§!\n\n§HWe hear the sounds of the biome from earlier. Still, nobody is present.§!
Trace the source of the transmission.
This is a waste of time.

entries.zh: 我们应该能追踪到这个怪异通讯的源头。
entries.en: We may be able to trace the source of the anonymous transmissions we have been receiving.

entries.zh: 我们可以定位这个神秘通讯的源头。通过信号的追踪我们发现了许多不同的坐标点，我们确定这是来自一个移动物体上的通讯。我们的理论认为我们应该是与一艘舰船发生了通讯，一艘可能用于自然保留地之类作用的舰船。
entries.en: We were able to locate the source of the mysterious transmissions. On tracing the signals to multiple points of origin, we have ascertained they must be coming from a moving object. Our leading theory suggests we were contacted by a ship, which may be used as a nature reserve of sorts.

entries.zh: §H我们建立了通讯，然后再一次听到了那个生物群系熟悉的声音。然而，这次我们听到了人的说话声，§!\n\n诚挚地向你们问好，[owner.GetAdjective]！我对你们有所期待。原谅我的唐突，但我必须知道你们有多少好奇心。现在让我问你一件事。你们如何看待生命?
entries.en: §HWe establish communication, and are met with the now familiar sounds of the biome. However, this time we hear someone speaking,§!\n\nWarm greetings, [owner.GetAdjective]! I've been expecting you. Pardon the pretense, but I had to know how curious you were. Now let me ask you something. How do you value life?

entries.zh:
啊。你最好还是不要打断寒暄吧？很好，我先介绍一下我自己。

§H在这位植物类生物的面容上绽开了花朵般的微笑。§!

我叫§Y艾莎琳§!。但在你们回答我的问题之前，我不会再说更多了。告诉我吧，你们认为生命有什么价值？
entries.en:
Ah. You'd rather not snip the pleasantries? Very well. Allow me to introduce myself.

§HA smile spreads across the plantoid's face.§!

I am §YAzaryn§!. But until you answer my question, I will say no more. Now tell me, what value do you ascribe to life?

entries.zh: 那要看情况。毕竟生命有很多不同的形式。
entries.en: That depends. Life comes in many forms.

entries.zh: 这是什么脑筋急转弯吗？
我能理解你不愿回答。但你必须明白，如果我能告诉你你更多信息的话我肯定会说。但我不能冒污染数据的险。再次请问，你们如何看待生命?
entries.en: I understand your reluctance to answer. You must understand, if I could give you more information I would. But I can't risk contaminating the data. Please, how do you value life?

entries.zh: 挺合理的回答。几乎所有人都会毫不犹豫地摘除可能危及自己生命的东西。但是我们要记住，所有的生命都有无限的潜力。\n\n现在，我来解释一下我联系你的原因。
entries.en: A sensible answer. Few would hesitate to remove something that would threaten life. Yet, it bears remembering that all life holds infinite potential.\n\nNow, I will shed some light on my reason for contacting you.

entries.zh:
§H这位植物类叹了口气。§!

终于见到了一个脑子里不只想着征服的民族。我也有同感，所有的生命都有无限的潜力。

现在，请允许我解释一下我联系您的原因。
entries.en:
§HThe plantoid sighs.§!

At last, a people with more than conquest on their minds. I share your sentiment. All life holds infinite potential.

Now, allow me to explain my reason for contacting you.

entries.zh: 我叫§Y艾莎琳§!，是来自艾莎提亚的一位前太空生物学家
entries.en: I am §YAzaryn§!, a former astrobiologist from Azathea

entries.zh: 我是一个来自艾莎提亚的前太空生物学家，
entries.en: I am a former astrobiologist from Azathea,

entries.zh:
后来成为了太空创生学者。我一直寻找可以创造新生命的材料。太空创生学需要的能量远超过我自己所能产生的。

§H艾莎琳顿了顿，继续说道§!

请相信我，这是物有所值的。但一开始有些困难。我想先送你一份礼物，看看你能否中和它。
entries.en:
turned scholar of astrocreation. I seek the materials needed to create new life. Astrocreation requires more energy than I can generate on my own.

§HAzaryn pauses before continuing,§!

I assure you, this is a worthwhile pursuit. But first, a challenge. I would like to send you a gift of sorts. See if you are able to neutralize it.

entries.zh:
艾莎提亚是我的家乡。它曾是一颗盖亚星球，是我们的帝国“星植丛”的首都，也是许多不同物种所栖息的家园。可惜，他们都已经不复存在了。

§H艾莎琳的目光游离了。§!

在其鼎盛时期，我们的星球令人无比叹为观止，上面充满了生命和自然之美。我想，这种生物多样性是前无古人后无来者的。但它最终还是分崩离析了。

现在，请小心对待我的礼物。
entries.en:
Azathea was my home. It was a gaia world, and the capital of the Astrophytan Plexus, my peoples' empire, and home to many different species. Sadly, they are all lost.

§HAzaryn's gaze drifts.§!

At its pinnacle our world was a wonder to behold, teeming with life and natural beauty. I imagine such biological diversity has scarcely existed since. But it all fell apart.

Now, treat my gift with care.

entries.zh: 问的很好。$paragon_astrocreation_is$\n\n很有趣吧？我送给你们的礼物就是向着这个目标的第一步。
entries.en: An excellent question. $paragon_astrocreation_is$\n\nAmazing, yes? The gift I send you is a first step toward that end.

entries.zh:
啊没错，这对不熟悉的人看起来确实太离奇了。没错，这就是我舰船的内部。

§H艾莎琳用手势示意四周。§!

这是“生息之所”。是一艘穹顶舰，其中包含内建的功能完整的生态系统。我承认，对此我非常自豪。

送给你们的礼物就是在这里培育的。
entries.en:
Ah yes, this may seem unusual to the uninitiated. Indeed, this is the interior of my ship.

§HAzaryn gestures to her surroundings.§!

This is the Vivarium. It is a dome ship, complete with a fully functioning integrated ecosystem. I admit, I am quite proud of it.

The gift I have given you was grown here.

entries.zh: 我们从艾莎琳那里收到的所谓礼物实际上是一种植物性细菌，且与我们所见过的任何细菌都不同。中和它将会是一个危险的挑战。然而，如果我们成功了，它将进一步加深我们对科学和医学的理解。
entries.en: The supposed gift we received from Azaryn is in fact a plant-based bacteria, unlike anything we've ever seen. Neutralizing it will provide a dangerous challenge. However, if we are successful, it would further our understanding of science and medicine.

entries.zh: 我们对艾莎琳的有机“礼物”取得了一定的进展。跨学科科学进步日益增长的潜力令人鼓舞。\n\n我们整理好了目前为止的发现，消除了该微生物的任何潜在威胁，并准备好再次联系艾莎琳。
entries.en: We have made progress with Azaryn's organic 'gift'. The growing potential for interdisciplinary scientific advancement is encouraging.\n\nWe have collated our findings, having neutralized any potential threat from the microorganism, and we are ready to contact Azaryn again.

entries.zh:
§H艾莎琳听到我们的进展非常开心。§!

太棒了！我非常感激，并为你们的努力喝彩。那么，[owner.GetName]，我还有另一个问题。

你会为了逃避死亡而夺取另一个人的生命吗？
entries.en:
§HAzaryn is delighted to hear of our breakthrough.§!

Wonderful! I appreciate and applaud your efforts. Now, [owner.GetName], I have another question.

To escape death, would you take the life of another?

entries.zh: 确实，大多数人都会这么选。毕竟生存是所有生物的驱动力。理解并接受这个事实也许有一天能拯救你，还有你的良心。\n\n$paragon.218.desc_flower$
entries.en: Indeed, most would. Survival is the driving force of all living things, after all. Understanding and accepting that fact might save you one day, and your conscience.\n\n$paragon.218.desc_flower$

entries.zh:
真的，你们真的不会吗？

§H艾莎琳挠了挠头。§!

我觉得这让人有点沮丧，也不可信。虽然我觉得这在某种程度上是令人钦佩的。要是这是真的就好了。

$paragon.218.desc_flower$
entries.en:
Truly, you would not?

§HAzaryn scratches her head.§!

I find that discouraging, and rather unconvincing. Although I suppose it's admirable in a way. If only it were true.

$paragon.218.desc_flower$

entries.zh: 在我的下一个请求之前，我还有一件礼物要给你们。这是艾莎提亚大王花，是一种我的舰船上原生的花卉。我给你的挑战是让它开花。暂时再会了。
entries.en: Before my next query, I have another gift for you. It is a Rafflesia Azathea, a type of flower, native to my ship. I challenge you to make it bloom. Farewell, for now.

entries.zh: 艾莎琳给我们一个任务，让我们尝试让一朵在她船上生态系统原生的巨大的花苞开花。基于初步的观测，这朵花可能对太空生物学有着极为重要的意义。
entries.en: Azaryn has tasked us with blooming a giant flower bud, native to her dome ship's ecosystem. Based on initial observations, this flower may be of great astrobiological significance.

entries.zh: 我们最初试图引起花苞的反应，但效果并不好。只有当使用超出通常安全参数的电刺激时，这朵花才能开放。我们已经完成了艾莎琳的最新任务，并准备再次与她联系。
entries.en: Our initial attempts to provoke a reaction from the flower bud were underwhelming. It was only when we applied electrical stimuli beyond our usual safety parameters that we were able to bring the flower to bloom. We have completed Azaryn's latest task, and are ready to contact her again.

entries.zh:
§H一只小巧的授粉无人机在艾莎琳的脑边嗡嗡作响。她温柔地把它挥开。§!

再次问好。艾莎提亚大王花真是一种有趣的植物，你们也赞同吧？进化真是一件奇妙的事情。我对于你们能对其施加合适量的能量来使其盛开感到印象深刻。

§H她兴奋地拍起了手。§!

又到了提问时间。在规模都很大的前提下，你们会为了拯救其他的生命而牺牲自己的同类吗？
entries.en:
§HA tiny pollination drone buzzes around Azaryn's head. She gently wafts it away.§!

Hello again. The Rafflesia Azathea sure is an interesting plant, wouldn't you agree? Evolution truly is a wondrous thing. I'm impressed you were able to apply the required amount of energy to make it bloom.

§HShe claps her hands excitedly.§!

Time for another question. Would you sacrifice your own kind if it meant you could save lives elsewhere, on a massive scale?

entries.zh:
§H艾莎琳心领神会地点了点头。§!

是的，也许这个答案很明显，但在那个场景之下，可能很难看到正确答案。我们必须抛下自己的情感，做出那些顾全大局的事情。

$paragon.224.desc_question$
entries.en:
§HAzaryn nods in understanding.§!

Yes, it may seem the obvious choice but, when caught up in the moment, it can be very hard to see it through. We must set aside our emotions and do what is best for the greater good.

$paragon.224.desc_question$

entries.zh:
§H艾莎琳同情地点了点头。§!

确实，这不是一件容易的事。我赞许你们的诚实。

然而我相信，为了顾全大局，智慧生命必须给那些无私的选择以更高的优先级。

$paragon.224.desc_question$
entries.en:
§HAzaryn nods sympathetically.§!

Indeed, it is not an easy thing to do. I appreciate your honesty.

However, it is my belief that for the betterment of all, intelligent life must always give precedence to the selfless choice.

$paragon.224.desc_question$

entries.zh: 我再问你们最后一个问题。\n\n你们在消灭威胁的时候会有任何迟疑吗？
entries.en: I have one final question for you.\n\nWould you hesitate to remove a threat?

entries.zh: 没错。决定性的行为确实需要三思。
我同意。果断很重要，但有些情况需要额外考虑。有时候你并不总是那么幸运，能够马上获得所有必要的信息。耐心对你大有好处。\n\n$paragon.226.desc_end$
entries.en: I agree. Decisiveness is vital, but some situations require extra consideration. Sometimes you are not fortunate enough to have all of the necessary information right away. Patience could benefit you greatly.\n\n$paragon.226.desc_end$

entries.zh: 你喜欢有时间思考。不幸的是，有时间思考可是一种特权。决定是一定有做出的，而片刻的深思熟虑可能是成功与失败的区别。\n\n$paragon.226.desc_end$
entries.en: Ah, you like having time to think. Unfortunately, one does not always have the privilege of extra time. Decisions must be made, and a moment of deliberation could be the difference between success and failure.\n\n$paragon.226.desc_end$

entries.zh: §H艾莎琳沉默片刻，然后给出了结论：§!\n\n很好，我已经问了你们够多问题了。你们给予了我非常多的耐心。我会花一点时间收集这些信息。我们很快会再一次谈话的。
entries.en: §HAzaryn is quiet for a moment. Then concludes:§!\n\nWell, I have asked you enough questions. You possess admirable patience. I will take some time to collate this information. We shall speak again soon.

entries.zh:
你好！你们已经向我展示了你们的实力。我希望能适时教会你们利用我的太空创生之力。

§H艾莎琳鞠了一躬。§!

我们会携手让星系再度变得郁郁葱葱。
entries.en:
Hello again! You have proven your potential. In time I hope to teach you to utilize my astrocreation powers.

§HAzaryn bows.§!

Together, we will reinvigorate the galaxy.

entries.zh:
你好，[owner.GetAdjective]。很高兴再次见到你们。

尽管我们有许多的不同，但我希望你们能记得我的教导，并学会用创生学的知识造福星系。
entries.en:
Hello, [owner.GetAdjective]. I am pleased to see you again.

Despite our differences, it is my hope that you will embrace my teaching, and learn to utilize astrocreation for the good of the galaxy.

entries.zh:
啊，[owner.GetAdjective]。诚挚地向你们问好。我的结论是，你们是太空创生学杰出的继承人！

§H艾莎琳微笑着。§!

我们将携手将生命播撒向虚空。我们将携手为所有人带去希望！
entries.en:
Ah, [owner.GetAdjective]. Warm greetings. I have concluded that you are an excellent advocate for astrocreation!

§HAzaryn smiles.§!

Together we shall breathe life into the void. Together, we shall inspire hope for all!

entries.zh: 只要你努力创造新生命，我的技能和我的船愿为你所用。如果你喜欢，我很乐意加入你。
entries.en: As long as you strive to create new life, my skills and my ship are at your disposal. If this pleases you, I will gladly join you.

entries.zh: 所以太空创生学到底是什么？

对哦，请原谅我。我太激动了，差点忘了解释最重要的细节。但也许最好进行一个展示以方便理解……

$paragon_astrocreation_is$

是的，很快你将亲自见证一次太空创生。
entries.en:
Ah yes, forgive me. In my excitement, I have neglected to explain this most important detail. But perhaps a demonstration would be best...

$paragon_astrocreation_is$

Yes, soon you may witness astrocreation for yourself.

entries.zh: 太空创生是一种高等级的环境改造。它是如此地强大。在一颗行星上播种一颗我的环境改造之核——§H艾莎琳指了指她背后的花苞§!——我们就能将几乎任何一种行星改造成一颗欣欣向荣的盖亚星球。这个过程需要许多能量，但结果是非常壮观的。
entries.en: Astrocreation is an advanced variant of terraformation. It is incredibly powerful. By seeding a planet with one of my Terraformation Nuclei--§HAzaryn indicates the buds on her back§!--we will be able to transform almost any planet into a thriving Gaia World. The process requires a great deal of energy, but the results are nothing short of spectacular.

entries.zh: §H$NAME_Astrocreator_Azaryn$§!作为一位§Y领袖§!加入了我们帝国。

entries.en: What are those things on your back?

entries.zh:
§H艾莎琳似乎对这个问题很惊讶。§!

简言之，这是我们物种独有的一种特质。在我们年轻的时候，它们会快速生长——我必须补充一下，会有点儿不舒服——并且需要定期修剪，不然它就会把我们自己压垮。§H她微笑着。§!但是啊，等到了我这个年纪，这种小烦恼就是遥远的怀念了。

它们其实并不是种子，但能发挥相似的作用。我将其命名为环境改造之核。其中沉睡着成长、重生和生命的潜力。
entries.en:
§HAzaryn appears surprised at the question.§!

A trait unique to my species, simply put. In our youth, they grow quickly - not without discomfort, I might add - and must be pruned regularly, lest we be weighed down by them. §HShe smiles.§! At my age, however, such troubles are a thing of the past.

They are not quite seeds, but it would do for an analogy. I've come to call them Terraformation Nuclei. Within them sleeps the potential for growth, for rebirth, and for life.

entries.zh: 你那台嗡嗡作响的小无人机是什么？
entries.en: What is that buzzing, tiny drone of yours?

entries.zh: 啊，你说这个？§H艾莎琳温柔地抱起那只小小的飞虫。§!这是一只授粉无人机。它们能确保我飞船上生态系统生机勃勃，生生不息。\n\n它们并不是完全无机的，甚至还有自行产生花粉的能力。§H艾莎琳指了指无人机的尾部。§!它们甚至可以利用电池末端的静电来调节花粉的传递。很可爱吧？
entries.en: Ah, this one? §HAzaryn gently lifts the little flier.§! This is a pollination drone. They help to ensure the vigor and future of my ship's ecosystem.\n\nThey're not altogether inorganic, and even possess the ability to produce pollen on their own. §HAzaryn points at the drone's bottom.§! They can even regulate pollen-transferral by use of static magnetism from their battery terminals. Adorable, isn't it?

entries.zh:
§H艾莎琳正在控制台上飞快地输入着，调节着一些仪器。§!

太棒了！我定位了你的首都开始导航，很快就能到你们那儿。

欧我差点忘了，我舰船的生态系统也是许多外激素的家。
entries.en:
§HTyping quickly into a command console, Azaryn adjusts some instruments.§!

Wonderful! I have plotted a course for your capital, and will be arriving shortly.

Oh, and before I forget, my ship's ecosystem is home to a wide variety of ectohormones.

entries.zh: 感觉我给你这些§Y信息素§!应该挺合适的。它们与你们的物种可以兼容，一定能提供一些正面效果的。
entries.en: It seems appropriate I give you these §Ypheromones§!. They are compatible with your species, and are sure to provide some positive effects.

entries.zh: 为了纪念我们的合作，我准备了一份§Y信息素§!作为礼物。这不是我最杰出的工作，但还是会为你们的人民带来一些正面的效果。
entries.en: To commemorate our collaboration, I have prepared a gift of §Ypheromones§!. It's not my best work, but they will provide some positive effects to your people.

entries.zh: 为了纪念此刻的愉悦，请接收这份§Y信息素§!作为礼物。里面包含了一些可以为你的人民带去好处的化合物。很值得一用。
entries.en: To mark this joyous occasion, please accept this gift of §Ypheromones§!. They contain a potent compound which will bring certain benefits to your people. It is well deserved.

entries.zh: 该行星被其中一颗§Y$NAME_Astrocreator_Azaryn$§!的核心环境改造了。
entries.en: This planet was terraformed by one of §Y$NAME_Astrocreator_Azaryn$§!'s Nuclei.

entries.zh: 在§Y$NAME_Astrocreator_Azaryn$的§!背上的花苞。她对它们是保密的。\n§H剩余三个花苞。§!
entries.en: The buds on §Y$NAME_Astrocreator_Azaryn$'s§! back. She is secretive about them.\n§HThree buds remain.§!

entries.zh: 在§Y$NAME_Astrocreator_Azaryn$的§!背上的花苞。她的健康似乎依赖于它们。\n§H剩余两个花苞§!
entries.en: The buds on §Y$NAME_Astrocreator_Azaryn$'s§! back. Her health seems reliant on them.\n§HTwo buds remain.§!

entries.zh: 在§Y$NAME_Astrocreator_Azaryn$的§!背上的花苞，是她的力量之源，艾莎林需要依赖其生存。\n§R剩余最后一个花苞。§!
entries.en: The buds on §Y$NAME_Astrocreator_Azaryn$'s§! back, and the source of her powers. Azaryn needs them to survive.\n§RA single bud remains.§!

entries.zh: §Y$NAME_Astrocreator_Azaryn$§!的健康情况肉眼可见地恶化了。她拒绝接受检查，所以我们什么都帮不上。
entries.en: §Y$NAME_Astrocreator_Azaryn$§!'s health has visibly declined. She refuses to be examined, so we are unable to help her.

entries.zh: 我们现在确信§Y$NAME_Astrocreator_Azaryn$§!的健康与环境改造之核密不可分。每用掉一个核心，她的健康状况就变糟糕一分，我们猜测一旦用掉最后一个核，她将会死去。
entries.en: We now know for certain that §Y$NAME_Astrocreator_Azaryn$§!'s health is inherently tied to her Terraformation Nuclei. Her condition worsened after each use, and we now suspect that upon seeding her final Nuclei, she will die.

entries.zh:
§H$NAME_Astrocreator_Azaryn$还在。她舰船上日常的叽叽喳喳变成了一种低沉的哼鸣。她用一种暗哑的声音低语。§!

我并不悲伤。那些星球会欣欣向荣的，我很荣幸献出了自己的生命。谢谢你们，朋友。

§H她走了。§!
entries.en:
§H$NAME_Astrocreator_Azaryn$ is still. The usual cacophony of sound from her ship has fallen to a low hum. She speaks in a strained whisper.§!

I am not sad. So worlds may thrive, I have gladly given my life. Thank you, friends.

§HShe is gone.§!

entries.zh: 在§Y$NAME_Astrocreator_Azaryn$§!死后，她的穹顶舰所残余之物。
entries.en: The remains of §Y$NAME_Astrocreator_Azaryn$§!'s dome ship, left behind after her death.

entries.zh:
§H我们收到了一份预先录制的信息。是来自艾莎琳的。§!

虽然我接纳了自己的牺牲，但我无法接受生息之所以及船上的万物和我一起死去的这件事。这艘舰船与我紧密相连，当我枯萎时，它也会枯萎。

我对此有所预见，所以生息之所是以模块化设计的，其中的每个生态系统都能够自我维持。准备工作已经都提前做好了，你们只需要找到一颗行星重新把栖息地安置下来。我相信你们能完成这项任务。
entries.en:
§HWe receive a pre-recorded message. It is from Azaryn.§!

Although I accept my sacrifice, I cannot stand the thought of the Vivarium and the lifeforms on board dying with me. The ship is profoundly linked to me, and when I wither, it will too.

In anticipation of this, I designed the Vivarium in a modular fashion, with each ecosystem capable of sustaining itself. Preparations have been made, and all you need to do is find a planet to rehome the habitat. I trust you to complete this task.

entries.zh: 艾莎琳的§Y$building_contained_ecosphere$§!选址重建的准备工作已经完成。可以重建在一颗我们选定的行星上。
entries.en: Preparations for the relocation and reconstruction of Azaryn's §Y$building_contained_ecosphere$§! have been made. It may be reconstructed on a planet of our choosing.

entries.zh: §Y$NAME_Astrocreator_Azaryn$§!的遗产，是在她去世时遗留给我们的。它只是生息之所内建生态系统的一小部分。\n\n向该行星的引入高浓度的§H$contained_ecosphere_pheromones$§!，对人口施加正面影响。
entries.en: §Y$NAME_Astrocreator_Azaryn$§!'s legacy, left to us when she passed. It is but a small section of the Vivarium's internal ecosystem.\n\nIntroduces a high concentration of §H$contained_ecosphere_pheromones$§! to a planet's atmosphere, applying positive effects to the population.

entries.zh: §H$building_contained_ecosphere$§!有规律释放的有益信息素，对人口带来正面效应。
entries.en: Beneficial pheromones regularly released by §H$building_contained_ecosphere$§!, applying positive effects to the population.

entries.zh: 我们的一位科学家自行从§Y$NAME_Astrocreator_Azaryn$§!的环境改造之核上悄悄取下的一份样本。\n\n对该花苞的研究可以提供一些现阶段艾莎琳还没打算分享的有价值的信息。
entries.en: Acting of their own volition, one of our scientists has covertly obtained a sample from one of §Y$NAME_Astrocreator_Azaryn$§!'s Terraformation Nuclei.\n\nResearching this bud could provide valuable information which Azaryn does not seem inclined to share at this stage.

entries.zh:
§H$NAME_Astrocreator_Azaryn$松了口气。§!

你们能决定将这个还给我，我的感激之情无法言表。如果不能正确控制这种力量，结果可能是灾难性的。

值得庆幸的是，历史不会重演。为了奖励你的诚实，我会准备一批新的费洛蒙。
entries.en:
§H$NAME_Astrocreator_Azaryn$ is relieved.§!

I cannot understate my gratitude that you have seen fit to return this. Without the proper means to control this power, the results could have been catastrophic.

Thankfully, history will not repeat itself. To reward your honesty, I will prepare a fresh batch of pheromones.

entries.zh:
我多言了。

§H艾莎琳摇了摇头。§!

干预自然会产生可怕的后果。在年轻的时候我技能尚不成熟，因此犯了一个错误……

我们的星球曾经欣欣向荣，美丽非凡。但一个小小的错误计算导致了一种意想不到的细菌的入侵。生态平衡被打破，随之而来的便是大灭绝。我们为自己的粗心大意付出了代价。
entries.en:
I've said too much.

§HAzaryn shakes her head.§!

Meddling with nature can have terrible consequences. In my younger days, before I honed my skills, I made a mistake...

Our planets were flourishing. They were beautiful. But a simple miscalculation led to the introduction of an unforeseen bacteria. The balance was tipped, and mass extinction followed. We were not cautious, and we paid the price.

entries.zh: 研究我们从§Y$NAME_Astrocreator_Azaryn$§!的环境改造之核获取的样本可以提升我们对该科技的理解。
entries.en: Studying the sample we obtained of §Y$NAME_Astrocreator_Azaryn$§!'s terraformation nucleus could enhance our understanding of this technology.

entries.zh: 我们的秘密科学团队通过研究§Y$NAME_Astrocreator_Azaryn$§!的核心样本中学到很多东西。这个计划完成了，而艾莎琳对此毫不知情。
entries.en: Our covert science team has been able to learn a lot from studying the sample of §Y$NAME_Astrocreator_Azaryn$§!'s nucleus. This project has concluded successfully, and Azaryn is none the wiser.

entries.zh: [event_target:nucleus_building_planet.GetName]上的设施遭受到了严重的结构破坏，被快速增殖的制备摧垮。研究环境改造之核样本的科学家无法控制局面了。
entries.en: The facility on [event_target:nucleus_building_planet.GetName] has suffered substantial structural damage and is overrun with rapidly growing vegetation. The scientists studying the Terraformation Nuclei sample cannot control the situation.

entries.zh: 我们必须坦白。联络艾莎琳。
entries.en: We must come clean. Contact Azaryn.
There is a small chance §Y$NAME_Astrocreator_Azaryn$§! will end our collaboration.

entries.zh:
§H艾莎琳有点惊讶。§!

欧，嗨！很高兴见到你！

不得不承认，我们合作带来的好处比我预想的要多得多。我们正在一起大步迈进。这样的事情只有我们互相信任才能实现。

§H她亲切地微笑着。§!
entries.en:
§HAzaryn is surprised.§!

 Oh, hello. Good to see you!

I must say this partnership is proving a greater boon than I would have imagined. We are making great strides together. Such things are only possible with trust.

§HShe smiles warmly.§!
We need to tell you something.

entries.zh:
我知道了。

§H她叹了口气。§!

行吧，损失已经发生了。幸好你们这么快就来联络我了。我们必须迅速行动。这需要你方大量的投入。有多少就拿出来多少，这样我们可以尽快结束掉这个问题。
entries.en:
I see.

§HShe sighs.§!

Well, the damage is done. It is lucky you contacted me sooner rather than later. We must act quickly. This will require a significant investment on your part. Give me what you can so we may end this.

entries.zh: 艾莎琳拿走了你全部的£energy£§H能量币§!。
我们研究环境改造之核样本的研究设施被毁了。由于一直无法阻止入侵性植物的蔓延，现在，新盛开的植物群正在释放出能引起皮肤起泡的花粉，这种花粉一旦吸入后果是致命的。这让[event_target:nucleus_building_planet.GetName]危在旦夕。
entries.en: The research facility where we were studying the Terraformation Nuclei sample has been devastated. We have been unable to stop the spread of invasive plant life. Now, the freshly bloomed flora are emitting skin-blistering pollen, which is highly toxic if inhaled. This puts [event_target:nucleus_building_planet.GetName] at risk.

entries.zh: 我们控制不住了。联络艾莎琳。
entries.en: We cannot contain this. Contact Azaryn.

entries.zh: 治疗那些在我们核心样本研究事故中受到损伤的人们需要一些时间。
entries.en: Treating the injuries sustained during our failed Nuclei sample research attempt will take some time.

entries.zh:
§H$NAME_Astrocreator_Azaryn$非常地沮丧。§!

我早知道了你们的贪婪，但我没想到你们竟还如此狂妄，甚至将自己人民的安危置于不顾。他们已经岌岌可危了！

我正在为这个过度增生准备应对措施。但是因为你的玩忽职守造成的伤者需要紧急治疗。
entries.en:
§H$NAME_Astrocreator_Azaryn$ is crestfallen.§!

I knew you were greedy, but I did not expect you to be so proud that you would risk hurting your own people. They are dying!

I am preparing countermeasures to end this rampant growth. But the victims of your negligence will require immediate medical treatment.

entries.zh: 我们会好好照顾他们的。
entries.en: We will take care of them.

entries.zh: 我们伟大的§Y[From.GetTitle][From.GetName]§!为国鞠躬尽瘁，享年[From.GetAge]岁。人们高呼，为了纪念这位领袖对§Y[Root.GetName]§!的贡献，要举办一场盛大的追思仪式。这一盛事能将民众团结在一起，巩固我们的理念。
entries.en: Our great §Y[From.GetTitle] [From.GetName]§! has passed away at the age of [From.GetAge] while in service to our empire. The people clamor for a memorial service to honor this leader's contribution to the §Y[Root.GetName]§!. A grand event will give everyone closure, and bolster our ideals.

entries.zh: 一场私人葬礼就足够了。

entries.en: [From.GetHeSheCap] did nothing to deserve such honors.

entries.zh: 规划一场盛大的追悼游行。马上。
以[From.GetHisHer]的名义设立一个基金。
entries.en: Set up a foundation in [From.GetHisHer] name.

entries.zh: 建立一座适合的纪念碑。
一场小规模的悼念会就足够了。
以[From.GetHisHer]的名字命名一个地标。

entries.en: [From.GetHisHerCap] story does not have to end here...
The [Root.GetRulerTitle] wishes to consume the Honored one.
§Y[Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName]§! will consume §Y[From.GetName]§!, gaining a new trait.
§Y[Root.GetRulerTitle] [Root.GetRulerName]§! will consume §Y[From.GetName]§!, completing half of the current ['concept_agenda'].

entries.zh: 在长长的游行队伍中，§Y[From.GetName]§!静静地沉眠，§Y[Root.GetName]§!的每一位公民都受邀前来表示敬意。\n\n葬礼之后是为期一周的盛大祭典，祭典花费巨大。§Y[From.GetName]§!的透明水晶棺材在§Y[Root.Capital.GetName]§!纪念堂展出。人群排在街头，想要一睹他们伟大领袖的最终安息之处。
entries.en: §Y[From.GetName]§! has been laid to rest following a public procession. Every citizen of §Y[Root.GetName]§! was invited to pay their respects.\n\nThe funeral is followed by a week-long festival, with no expenses spared. §Y[From.GetName]§!'s translucent crystal casket is displayed at the §Y[Root.Capital.GetName]§! memorial site, where the crowds line the streets hoping to catch a glimpse of the great leader in their final resting place.

entries.zh: §Y[From.GetName]§!在最亲近的亲属和同事的环绕中静静地沉眠。其对§Y[Root.GetName]§!的贡献不菲，但现在并不是能铺张浪费的时候。
entries.en: §Y[From.GetName]§! is laid to rest in a private ceremony with their closest family members and colleagues. Their contribution to the §Y[Root.GetName]§! was an important one, but now is not the time for exorbitant expenditure.

entries.zh: 我们对§Y[From.GetTitle]§!§Y[From.GetName]§!的谨慎处置被媒体迅速捕捉到了。尽管一些人表达了担忧，但许多消息来源还是坚定地指出了这位领袖的缺点。当前的普遍看法是，我们终于可以找一位更合适的继任者来替代现在这位领袖了。\n\n
entries.en: The discreet disposal of our §Y[From.GetTitle]§!, §Y[From.GetName]§!, has been promptly noted by the press. While others express concern, many sources adamantly point out the leader's shortcomings. The general sentiment is relief that we can now replace this leader with a more fitting successor.\n\n
It is time to move on.

entries.zh: 在一场简短的追悼会后，[From.GetTitle]的遗体被捐赠给了科学界，以对基础医药研究和教育继续做贡献。\n\n这些过程中剩下的东西最终将被水火化，变成富含矿物质的肥料，确保身体的任何部分都不会被浪费。
entries.en: After a brief commemoration, the [From.GetTitle]'s body has been donated to science to contribute towards essential medical research and education.\n\nWhat is left from these procedures will in the end be water cremated and turned into a mineral-rich fertilizer, ensuring no part of the body goes to waste.
Such is the cycle of life.

entries.zh: 人们聚集在一起，追悼§Y[From.GetName]§!的一生及其丰功伟绩。人们挤满了街道，向东望不见头，向西望不见尾。颂歌一直唱到了夜幕降临。[From.GetHeSheCap]现在已经跨入彼岸。\n\n[From.GetHisHer]的布道节选现在在整个帝国回荡，提醒着我们共同的目标。
entries.en: The people gathered in their masses to celebrate the life and career of §Y[From.GetName]§!. Huge processions filled the streets, and hymns were sung long into the night. [From.GetHeSheCap] is now waiting for us on the other side of the veil.\n\nPopular excerpts from [From.GetHisHer] sermons are now reverberating across the empire, reminding us of our common goal.

entries.zh: 大型阅兵方阵和舰队护卫着§Y[From.GetName]§!的灵柩前往最终安息之地。[From.GetHisHerCap]的遗体被发射去了最近的恒星，并全程向全社会广播。\n\n逝世领袖的个人战略部署和日志成为了下一批军校学员课程中的内容。
entries.en: A huge parade of troops and a flyover by naval forces marked the arrival of §Y[From.GetName]§!'s casket to its final resting place. [From.GetHisHerCap] body was fired into the nearest star during a society-wide broadcast.\n\nThe departed leader's personal strategies and log books will become a part of the curriculum for the next generation of cadets.

entries.zh: 为了纪念刚刚去世的伟大§Y[From.GetTitle]§!，§Y[From.GetName]§!，我们设立了一个非盈利的基金会。这个基金会标志着星际的和平与和谐发展迈出了一步，包容了不同社群和物种之间的分歧。
entries.en: A non-profit foundation has been established to honor the passing of the great §Y[From.GetTitle]§!, §Y[From.GetName]§!. The foundation marks a step towards peace and interstellar harmony, bridging differences between communities and species.

entries.zh: 我们共同创造了一项遗产。
当§Y[From.GetName]§!去世的消息传遍更远的地区时，一种深深的悲痛笼罩了整个帝国。无数的哀悼者遵循传统的葬礼仪式加入了§Y[Root.Capital.GetName]§!的葬礼队伍中。\n\n其遗体被一丝不苟地清洁并进行了适当的装饰。在§Y[From.GetTitle]§!的遗体进行了安葬之前，我们全国上下都要默哀，表示尊重。
entries.en: A deep sorrow has gripped the public as news regarding the passing of §Y[From.GetName]§! spreads to the wider community. Countless mourners join the funeral procession on §Y[Root.Capital.GetName]§! to follow the traditional funeral rites.\n\nThe body is meticulously cleansed and appropriately decorated. Before the deceased §Y[From.GetTitle]§! is laid to rest, a moment of silence is observed throughout our systems as a mark of respect.

entries.zh: 为纪念§Y[From.GetName]§!一生的丰功伟绩，我们为[From.GetHimHer]准备了一场穿越星海的最后航行。\n\n一个容纳着[From.GetTitle]遗体的胶囊被庄严地发射向未探索的宇域，伴随他的还有诗歌、图表、录音和其他贵宾带来的随葬品。将来有一天，[From.GetTitle]的船只可能会在那里找到一个新家，完成[From.GetHisHer]的最后任务。
entries.en: The remarkable deeds of §Y[From.GetName]§! have warranted [From.GetHimHer] one last voyage through space.\n\nA capsule containing the [From.GetTitle]'s remains is ceremonially launched into the void alongside poems, charts, recordings, and other memorabilia brought by various dignitaries. One day the [From.GetTitle]'s vessel may find a new home out there, completing [From.GetHisHer] final mission.

entries.zh: 工匠们获得最好的材料来制作§Y[From.GetName]§!的肖像，将其加入到§Y[Root.GetName]§!传奇英雄的行列中。其庄严的面孔被蚀刻在石头和金属上，让人们牢记这位强大领袖的丰功伟绩。
entries.en: Artisans have been provided with the finest materials to fashion the likeness of §Y[From.GetName]§!, adding them to the long line of storied heroes of the §Y[Root.GetName]§!. Their majestic visage is etched in stone and metal, acting as a reminder of what strong leaders can accomplish.

entries.zh: 您的伟大将被永远铭记。
§Y[From.GetName]§!的名字与头衔被镌刻在了一座高大耸立的纪念碑上，与无数其他为§Y[Root.GetName]§!的人民鞠躬尽瘁的人们并列。这位备受尊敬的§Y[From.GetTitle]§!将被人民永远铭记，他的贡献为未来数代领袖们开拓道路。
entries.en: §Y[From.GetName]§!'s name and title are carved on a towering monument alongside others who have served the §Y[Root.GetName]§! for the good of its population. The respected §Y[From.GetTitle]§! will be fondly remembered by the people, paving the way for future generations of leaders.
For the good of the many.

entries.zh: 这位领袖的去世引起了星际证交所短暂但剧烈的震荡。\n\n除了举办奢华的葬礼，§Y[Root.GetName]§!还将一座较高的摩天楼重命名为[From.GetName]大厦以确保以后这位[From.GetTitle]的名字会被写入公司的编年史中。每间会议室的墙上都挂着一幅经过艺术诠释的肖像，以纪念其对帝国的杰出贡献。
entries.en: News of the leader's passing is met with a sharp, but brief downturn in share value at the galactic stock markets.\n\nIn addition to sponsoring the lavish funeral, §Y[Root.GetName]§! rebrands one of its taller skyscrapers as the [From.GetName] Building to ensure that the late [From.GetTitle]'s name is preserved in the annals of the corporate history. An artistically interpreted portrait is also hung on every boardroom wall to commemorate their outstanding contributions to the empire.

entries.zh: §Y[From.Species.GetName]§!的去世并不像表面上看起来那么彻底。尽管躯干已经开始劣化，但核心还可以恢复活力。\n\n在浸泡过一种特殊的激素溶液后，§Y[From.GetName]§!的遗体被小心翼翼地埋入§Y[burial_planet.GetName]§!的土壤中。埋葬地由孵化者精心照料，他们耐心地等待幼体破土发芽，开始新的循环。
entries.en: The death of a §Y[From.Species.GetName]§! is not as final as it appears. Even if the main stem has begun to deteriorate, the roots can be reinvigorated.\n\nAfter soaking in a special hormone solution, §Y[From.GetName]§!'s remains are carefully buried in the soil of §Y[burial_planet.GetName]§!. The burial site is tended by brood members who patiently await for younglings to sprout on the surface, starting the cycle anew.
From one life to the next.

entries.zh: §Y[From.GetTitle][From.GetName]§!在可靠地服务了[From.GetYearsOfService]后发生了故障，彻底报废。我们的科学家已经备份了文件以保留重要数据。\n\n基于§Y[From.GetName]§!的智能全息图谱已经被安装在我们的舰船系统中，作为虚拟顾问为我们服务。他们将继续支援我们的任务。
entries.en: §Y[From.GetTitle] [From.GetName]§! has broken down after [From.GetYearsOfService] of reliable service. Our scientists have backed up their files to preserve important data.\n\nAn intelligent hologram based on §Y[From.GetName]§! has been installed in our ship systems to serve as a virtual advisor. They will continue to aid in our mission.

entries.zh: 死亡不再是一项障碍了。
entries.en: Death is no longer an obstacle.

entries.zh: §Y[From.GetTitle][From.GetName]§!的意识在[From.GetAge]岁时从集体意识中移除。我们是§Y[Root.GetName]§!，我们将永存。
entries.en: The mind of §Y[From.GetTitle] [From.GetName]§! was removed from the collective at the age of [From.GetAge]. We are the §Y[Root.GetName]§!. We will endure.

entries.zh: 我们从§Y[system_killed_in.GetName]§!恒星系收到了噩耗。我们德高望重的科学家§Y[leader_killed.GetName]§!的舰队在一场残酷的战斗中被§Y[country_killed_by.GetName]§!彻底消灭。\n\n在最后的无私行动中，机组人员发出一条传输信息，其中包含了§Y[leader_killed.GetName]§!最新的研究成果。为纪念§Y[leader_killed.GetName]§!而举行的特别假期计划已经开始执行。
entries.en: We have received grave news from the §Y[system_killed_in.GetName]§! system. Our renowned scientist §Y[leader_killed.GetName]§!'s fleet was completely destroyed by §Y[country_killed_by.GetName]§! in a brutal battle.\n\nIn a final act of selflessness, the crew sent out a transmission containing all of §Y[leader_killed.GetName]§!'s latest research. Plans to honor §Y[leader_killed.GetName]§!'s memory with a special holiday have been set in motion.
Their sacrifices were not in vain.

entries.zh: 在§Y[country_killed_by.GetName]§!的恶意攻击下，我们伟大的科学家§Y[leader_killed.GetName]§!在§Y[system_killed_in.GetName]§!的战斗中陨落。\n\n这种野蛮的行径使我们全国上下震怒。我们的人民大声呼吁要讨回公道。我们要在能力的范围内千方百计确保§Y[country_killed_by.GetName]§!为这一天犯下的卑鄙行径而后悔。
entries.en: After a vicious attack by §Y[country_killed_by.GetName]§!, our great scientist §Y[leader_killed.GetName]§! has perished at the battle of §Y[system_killed_in.GetName]§!.\n\nThis act of brutality has shocked us profoundly. Our people are screaming for justice. We should do everything in our power to ensure §Y[country_killed_by.GetName]§! regrets this despicable act of violence.

entries.zh: 一位优秀的科学家最近从雷达屏幕上消失。在§Y[leader_killed.GetName]§!误入了§Y[system_killed_in.GetName]§!星系中的战斗后，我们很快与[leader_killed.GetHeShe]失去了联系。\n\n这对我们帝国是无可估量的损失。必须立刻采取措施预防此类损失的发生。
entries.en: A skilled scientist has recently fallen off the radar. We lost contact with §Y[leader_killed.GetName]§! after [leader_killed.GetHeShe] entered combat in the system of §Y[system_killed_in.GetName]§!.\n\nThis has been recorded as a significant loss to our empire. Measures to counter this loss must be taken immediately.

entries.zh: 必须立刻寻找此人的替补。
我们要铭记此人的消亡。

entries.en: The odds were stacked against us.

entries.zh: 一位伟大的领袖在公开的葬礼后安葬，人民紧紧地团结在了一起。
entries.en: A great leader has been laid to rest following a public procession, bringing the people closer together.

entries.zh: 一位伟大的领袖在私下的追悼会中安葬。普通民众丧失了释怀的机会。
entries.en: A great leader has been laid to rest in a private ceremony. The general public have been denied closure for their loss.

entries.zh: 这位长期在岗的领袖的去世，出乎意料地让许多互相敌对的派系关系紧密了起来。他们愿意互相协作，来解决这位逝去之人留下的烂摊子。
entries.en: The death of our long-serving leader has had the unexpected effect of bringing opposing parties closer. They are willing to work together to fix the mistakes of the deceased.

entries.zh: 我们已故领袖的解剖学捐献果然是大有裨益的，能继续为我们的学术工作提供支持。
entries.en: The anatomical donation of our late leader has proved itself beneficial, continuing to bolster our academic endeavors.

entries.zh: 当我们伟大领袖逝世时，我们可以在彼此之间找到安慰和安心。
entries.en: As our great leader ascends to a plane of non-existence, we will find comfort and reassurance in each other.

entries.zh: 一位伟大领袖的灵柩在军队的护驾下前往最终安息之地，我们的力量在星海中彰显。
entries.en: A great leader has been escorted to their final resting place by a military parade, projecting our might to the galaxy.

entries.zh: 为了纪念这位已故的伟大领袖，人们建立了一个基金会来弥合我们社群之间的分歧。
entries.en: To honor the late great leader, a foundation has been established to bridge the differences between our communities.

entries.zh: 为追悼逝去的领袖举行的传统葬礼仪式，让人们想起了他们曾经团结一致的过往。这一事件提醒我们回顾历史，将我们同古老的传统方式再次连接在一起。
entries.en: The traditional funeral rites which marked the passing of our late leader have reminded the people of their united past. The event has reminded us of our history, and reconnected us to our old ways.

entries.zh: 我们已故的领袖已经启程迎接新的旅程。团结一致，我们受到鼓舞，百尺竿头，更进一步。
entries.en: Our late leader has been sent on a new journey. Together, we are inspired to push boundaries, and keep moving forward.

entries.zh: 一座高耸的纪念碑铭记我们的荣耀。
entries.en: Our glory is commemorated by a towering monument.

entries.zh: 这位领袖的名字同其他为帝国进步做出贡献的人合在一起，永垂不朽。
entries.en: The name of the great leader has been immortalized alongside the names of all who have served our society.

entries.zh: 一座以已故领袖命名的摩天大楼俯瞰着城市，向全国彰显其伟大。
entries.en: A skyscraper bearing the late leader's name looms over the city, advertising their significance to the empire.

entries.zh: 我们已故领袖的根基再次萌发出了绿芽，带来了又一次新生。
entries.en: The buried roots of our former leader have sprouted once more, bringing about a new beginning.

entries.zh: 一个全息智能，继承了我们已经损坏的领袖的全部经验，现在作为资深舰船顾问继续为我们服务。
entries.en: An intelligent hologram, with all the experience of our broken down leader, serves us as a veteran ship advisor.

entries.zh: 蜂巢已经失去了一个宝贵的工蜂。它们将被替换。
entries.en: The hive has lost a valuable drone. They will be replaced.

entries.zh: 集体失去了一个宝贵的共生体。它将被替换。
entries.en: The collective has lost a valuable symbiont. They will be replaced.

entries.zh: 一开始只是些许小小的争吵，现在已经演变成在每一项议题前都争论不休的僵局，这严重阻碍了我们内阁的运转效率。\n\n§Y[root.GetName]§!是内阁中最热衷于争吵和扰乱秩序的问题成员。许多人要求免去[root.GetHisHer]的席位，以恢复秩序和效率。
entries.en: What began as minor bickering has now devolved into quarrelsome gridlock on practically every issue brought before the Council, damaging its ability to function.\n\n§Y[root.GetName]§! has proven to be the most contentious and disruptive member of the Council. Many others are calling for [root.GetHisHer] removal so that order and efficiency can be restored.

entries.zh: 他们必须学会协同工作。
entries.en: They must learn to work together.

entries.zh: 一种罕见的宇宙现象的壮观促使§Y[root.GetName]§!达到了新的高度。兴奋和新想法席卷而来，唯一的问题是应该专注于哪个科学分支。
entries.en: The majesty of a rarely seen cosmic phenomenon has spurred §Y[root.GetName]§! to new heights. Brimming with excitement and new ideas, the only question is what branch of science they should focus on.

entries.zh: 我们的工程师们应该更懂得怎么利用它。
entries.en: Our engineers know exactly what to do with this.

entries.zh: 在§Y[root.GetName]§!富有冒险精神的亲自部署、亲自指挥下，我们查获了大批违禁品。这次行动酝酿了很长时间，其成功地削弱了在我国境内扎根的有组织的犯罪集团。
entries.en: Under the audacious regime of §Y[root.GetName]§!, we have accumulated a huge cache of seized contraband. The operation was a long time in the making, and its successful conclusion has crippled the organized crime syndicates that had taken root within our borders.

entries.zh: §Y[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]§!展现出了非凡的领导能力，将内阁团结了起来，确保了对我们社会的高效管理。充分运用统计学、传统和外交手段，[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]成功地安抚了内阁的其他成员，以及我们社会中的各个派系。
entries.en: §Y[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]§! has demonstrated  incredible leadership by uniting the council and ensuring the efficient administration of our society. Making use of statistics, tradition, and diplomacy, [event_target:leader_event_target.GetName] has managed to appease not only the other council members, but also our society's numerous factions.

entries.zh: 携手共进，我们就会更加强大。
entries.en: We are stronger when we work together.

entries.zh: §Y[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]§!以自我发现和发展为目的开始了一段旅程。[event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHer]的专心学习、刻苦钻研和善于自省，让[event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHerCap]的心智能力达到了一个全新的高度。现在，[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]决心挑战可能性的界限，并激励其他人去采摘星辰。
entries.en: §Y[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]§! has embarked on a journey of self-discovery and personal development. [event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHerCap] mental capabilities have reached new heights as a result of [event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHer] focused study, hard work and introspection. Now, [event_target:leader_event_target.GetName] is determined to push the boundaries of what is possible and inspire others to reach for the stars.

entries.zh: §Y[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]§!令人震惊的科学发现直接导致研究的效率大幅提高。[event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHerCap]的发现在科学圈中成了热门课题，他们现在将[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]视为思想领袖。
entries.en: As a direct result of §Y[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]§!'s astounding scientific discoveries, the rate at which we conduct research has accelerated. [event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHerCap] findings are a hot topic in the scientific community, which now recognizes [event_target:leader_event_target.GetName] as a thought leader.

entries.zh: 这些发展会让所有人收益。
我们发生了一次严重的信息泄露事故，许多敏感信息和关键的安保细节被公之于众。这些文件包含军事设施的编成表、神经交互界面实验、以及对几位重要的反对派人物的监视。\n\n§Y[root.GetName]§!在这次灾难事件中难辞其咎。
entries.en: A significant data leak has occurred, exposing sensitive information and crucial security details to the public. The files include schematics of military installations, details of neural interface experiments, and proof of surveillance of several prominent figures in the opposition.\n\n§Y[root.GetName]§! has been identified as the one responsible for this disaster.

entries.zh: §Y[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]§!成为了一位对普罗大众而言的潮流开创者。从[event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHer]的穿着风格到[event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHer]的说话方式，一切都吸引了大批追随者。[event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHerCap]的影响力扩展到了各个社会经济阶层，但[event_target:leader_event_target.GetSheHe]果然还是在年轻人中最受欢迎。
entries.en: §Y[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]§! has become a trendsetter among the general population. Everything from [event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHer] style to [event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHer] method of speech has attracted a sizable following. [event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHerCap] reach extends across all socioeconomic strata, but [event_target:leader_event_target.GetSheHe] has proven particularly popular among the youth.
We have no reason not to support this.

entries.zh: §Y[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]§!发表的热情洋溢的演讲在掀起了一股爱国狂潮。[event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHerCap]的赤子之心唤醒了我们全境内的责任感与民族热忱。
entries.en: The public have been swept up into a patriotic frenzy following a passionate speech delivered by §Y[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]§!. [event_target:leader_event_target.GetHisHerCap] unbridled passion has heightened the sense of responsibility and nationalistic zeal that is now being felt throughout our territories.

entries.zh: 统计分析表明§Y[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]§!已经发展出认知和行为上的很大程度的异质性，使其趋近于一个独立个体。\n\n我们无法准确预测自由意志的危害和潜在益处。现在必须作出决定：[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]应该保持现在的状态，还是应该强迫其回归正轨？
entries.en: Statistical analysis has confirmed that §Y[event_target:leader_event_target.GetName]§! has developed cognitive and behavioral idiosyncrasies of a magnitude that verge on the individual.\n\nThe risks and potential benefits of independent thought are beyond our ability to accurately predict. A decision has to be made: will [event_target:leader_event_target.GetName] be kept in this state, or should we force a correctional routine?

entries.zh: 把个体性抑制在萌芽状态。
§Y[root.GetName]§!深陷一场轰动全国的巨大丑闻。关于不当行为，挪用公款和掩盖真相的报道层出不穷，许多人甚至因此质疑起了当权者的能力。\n\n毫无疑问，这些事件对公众情绪的影响还会持续好多年。许多人相信，恢复公信力的唯一手段就是让[root.GetName]下台并接受公审。
entries.en: §Y[root.GetName]§! is at the center of a major scandal reverberating throughout the empire. There are numerous reports of aberrant behavior, embezzlement, and cover-ups. This has led many to question the competence of those in authority.\n\nThe effects on the public mood will undoubtedly be felt for years to come. Many believe that the only way to restore faith in the system is for [root.GetName] to step down and face prosecution.

entries.zh: 通过移除负面因素，内阁得到了强化。
entries.en: The council is strengthened by the removal of a negative participant.

entries.zh: 那位争执不休的内阁官员仍保留在岗位上，因此其他所有人的办事效率都降低了。
entries.en: With the quarrelsome councilor retaining office, efficiency across the board has diminished.

entries.zh: 我们的研究人员被宇宙现象启发，提升了研究产出。
entries.en: Our scientists are inspired by cosmic phenomena, increasing their research output.

entries.zh: 我们的安全部队突袭了当地的走私犯的主要仓库，他们可能要遇上点小小的经营困难喽。
entries.en: The local smugglers have a lot of problems operating after their main storage was raided by security forces.

entries.zh: 我们的内阁被共同目标凝聚到了一起。
entries.en: Our council is unified in their goals.

entries.zh: 得益于最近科学共同体的蓬勃发展，我们的研究人员更有动力从事实验和新技术的工作。
entries.en: Thanks to the recent upswing in the scientific community, our researchers are more motivated to work on experiments and new technologies.

entries.zh: 为此次事件负有责任的非专业人士还在担任政府高级官员，我们的社会因此引起了轩然大波。”
entries.en: Our society is in uproar as the amateur responsible for the leak is still working as a high-ranking government official.

entries.zh: 由于最近的文件泄露，我们的社会系统受到了损害，需要全面修复。
entries.en: Due to recent document leaks, our security systems are compromised and need a total overhaul.

entries.zh: 美学风潮来来去去，它在我们的公民中迅速传播，也同样迅速地消散。
entries.en: Aesthetics fads come and go, spreading rapidly among our citizens, and dissipating just as quickly.

entries.zh: 我们的人民被铿锵有力的演讲所激励，团结在了爱国的旗帜下。
entries.en: Invigorated by a powerful speech, the people are inspired under the banner of patriotism.

entries.zh: 个人主义倾向在很大程度上得到了抑制。尽管这造成了一定混乱，但也给了我们一次特别的机会开展研究。
entries.en: Individualistic tendencies are mostly contained. Although there has been some commotion, we also have unique opportunities to study these phenomena.

entries.zh: 个人主义倾向被研究并得到纠正，随之创造出了更团结的意识。
entries.en: Individualistic tendencies are studied and corrected, creating a more unified mind in the process.

entries.zh: 公民对继续保留这位可耻的内阁官员的决定表示愤慨并进行抗议。
entries.en: Citizens are protesting the decision to leave the scandalous councilor in position.

entries.zh: 公民们对我们罢免这位可耻内阁官员的决定表达了支持。
entries.en: Citizens support our decision to oust the scandalous councilor.

entries.en: The $TITLE$ presides over the religious council and guards against heresy.

The $TITLE$ runs promotional campaigns for the government.

entries.en: The $TITLE$ is responsible for maintaining vast archives of knowledge stored deep in vaults, and distributing this knowledge to those who seek it.
The $TITLE$ is responsible for generating trade.

entries.en: The $TITLE$ oversees training and development for all important leaders.

entries.zh: $TITLE$是各个矿业工会的代表，以其影响力来维持秩序。
entries.en: The $TITLE$ represents the mining guilds, whose influence helps to maintain order.
The $TITLE$ is the champion and pride of our society.
The $TITLE$ negotiates contracts for the navy.

entries.zh: $TITLE$确保议会聚焦在最重要的事务上。
entries.en: The $TITLE$ ensures our parliament is focusing on the most relevant issues.
The $TITLE$ commissions and oversees new workers.

entries.zh: $TITLE$负责为内阁在方方面面提供建议。
entries.en: The $TITLE$ serves to advise the council in all matters.

entries.zh: $TITLE$掌握着一笔可观的预算，为特权阶层提供奢华的娱乐。
entries.en: The $TITLE$ wields a substantial budget for keeping the privileged lavishly entertained.

entries.zh: $TITLE$确保国内社会中所有的内部威胁和异见者都被妥善处置。
entries.en: The $TITLE$ ensures any internal threats or dissidents within our society are swiftly dealt with.

entries.zh: $TITLE$是一个荣誉职位，负责给其他帝国的高官们留下深刻印象。
entries.en: The $TITLE$ is a ceremonial position for impressing alien dignitaries.

entries.zh: $TITLE$通过私人军事组织维持民事秩序。
entries.en: The $TITLE$ maintains civilian order via private military organizations.

entries.zh: $TITLE$能够协调对外星系的扩张事务。
entries.en: The $TITLE$ coordinates expansion efforts when claiming new systems.

entries.zh: $TITLE$全权负责建造和维护轨道空间站。
entries.en: The $TITLE$ is in charge of constructing and maintaining orbital stations.

entries.zh: $TITLE$负责提升我们在星系舞台上的形象。
entries.en: The $TITLE$ is responsible for improving our public image on the galactic stage.

entries.zh: $TITLE$保守着秘法，并负责任命新的死灵法师。
entries.en: The $TITLE$ guards the secret arts and ordains new necromancers.

entries.zh: $TITLE$将动员一切人力物力以确保工业扩张。
entries.en: The $TITLE$ will exploit anyone and anything to ensure industrial expansion.

entries.zh: $TITLE$成长于压力之下，并将不遗余力地证明自己的价值。
entries.en: The $TITLE$ thrives under pressure and will stop at nothing to prove their worth.

entries.zh: $TITLE$全权负责优化对舰船的打捞流程。
entries.en: The $TITLE$ is in charge of refining the salvaging process of scavenged ships.

entries.zh: $TITLE$明面上只是一名会议观察员，但暗地里却有着自己的议程。
entries.en: Officially, the $TITLE$ is merely an observer, but may have a hidden agenda.

entries.zh: $TITLE$确保所有的冤情都能得到平反。
entries.en: The $TITLE$ makes sure any grievances are settled promptly.

entries.zh: $TITLE$监管对奴隶的待遇，避免不必要的暴力冲突。
entries.en: The $TITLE$ oversees the treatment of slaves, to prevent unnecessary violence.

entries.zh: $TITLE$保障基础研究，并使其成果得以在各个部门间共享。
entries.en: The $TITLE$ ensures fundamental research is promoted and shared between departments.

entries.zh: $TITLE$宣传洗澡仪式的重要性和益处。
entries.en: The $TITLE$ promotes the importance and benefits of the bathing rituals.

entries.zh: $TITLE$全权负责协调贸易路线策划以最大化效率。
entries.en: The $TITLE$ is in charge of coordinating trade route scheduling to optimize capacity.

entries.zh: $TITLE$负责维护决斗礼仪，同时监管战争协议的正确执行。
entries.en: The $TITLE$ is responsible for maintaining dueling etiquette, and overseeing the correct execution of warfare protocols.

entries.zh: 知识商人负责海量宝库典藏的维护，并将知识分发给任何愿意为之付费的人。
entries.en: Dealers of Knowledge are responsible for maintaining the vast vault archives. They distribute the knowledge to those who are willing to pay for it.

entries.zh: 收购官是长期负责寻找有前途的私掠者或者有抢掠经验的人来壮大我们的行动。
entries.en: Acquisition Officers are constantly headhunting for promising privateers and those with plundering experience who could expand our operations.

entries.zh: 首席派驻官负责有效地处理所有委派任务。
entries.en: The Chief Posting Officer is responsible for the efficient handling of all delegation assignments.

entries.zh: 药业执行官代表着我们寰宇企业中的全体保健公司。
entries.en: The Pharmaceutical Executive is the representative for all healthcare corporations.

entries.zh: 过往的故事中饱含智慧。大讲古师通过讲述历史人物传说来激励我们的人民。
entries.en: Stories from the past contain much wisdom. Grand Storytellers inspire the population with traditional heroic tales.

entries.zh: 总监察长在腐败蔓延之前就寻找并根除它。
entries.en: The Primary Overseer seeks out corruption and extinguishes it before it can spread.

entries.zh: 通过民主程序指定的$TITLE$能够确保执行委员会和我们的工人同志之间能够进行清晰、简洁的沟通。
entries.en: The democratically-appointed $TITLE$ ensures clear and concise communication between executive committees and our worker members.

entries.zh: $TITLE$是我们做出关于集体的重要决定的位置。
entries.en: The $TITLE$ is where important decisions are made regarding the collective.

entries.zh: $TITLE$是我们发展对周遭世界理解的部位。
entries.en: The $TITLE$ is where we develop our understanding of the world around us.

entries.zh: $TITLE$是我们做出关于星系扩张决议的部位。
entries.en: The $TITLE$ is where decisions concerning galactic expansion are made.

entries.zh: $TITLE$是我们抵御突发反常意识的部位
entries.en: The $TITLE$ is where we counter the emergence of deviant consciousnesses.
$TITLE$: Units shall acquire all available worlds.

entries.zh: 最初由灵能军团进行导引，现在由$TITLE$负责给天选者庞大的灵能潜势提供媒介。
entries.en: First channeled by the Psi Corps, the $TITLE$ provides a conduit for the Chosen One's vast psionic potential.

entries.zh: 领袖有§Y灵媒§!或者§Y天选之人§!特质。
entries.en: Leader has the §YPsionic§! or a §YChosen§! Trait.

entries.zh: $TITLE$在整个星海帝国都有工作人员，监视任何可疑的行为。
entries.en: The $TITLE$ maintains operatives throughout the Galactic Imperium, monitoring any suspicious behavior.

entries.zh: 让我们促进技术发展并为之庆祝吧。
entries.en: Let's promote and celebrate our technological achievements.

entries.zh: 我们的政府需要进行扩充以容纳多一位内阁官员。
entries.en: We should expand our government to support an additional councilor.

entries.zh: 因为缺乏特定目标，我们会去处理一些琐碎的或是此前搁置的问题。
entries.en: Lacking a specific focus, we deal with smaller, otherwise deferred issues.

entries.zh: 由于政府工作重心的变化，我们应该改组内阁，把重点放在其他事务上。
entries.en: Due to changes in government focus, we should reorganize the Council to focus on other matters.

entries.zh: 在义体植入体产品的大规模发布之前，会有一段无利润的构思、开发和测试阶段。
entries.en: Major cyber implant-based product launch preceded by a period of unprofitable conceptualization, development and testing.

entries.zh: 确保互不侵犯的原则渗透在我们的社会和外交关系的方方面面。
entries.en: Ensure that non-aggression permeates our society and diplomatic relations.

entries.zh: 要让邻国知道，只要有必要，我们时刻准备着开战。
entries.en: Our neighbors will know we are prepared for war if necessary.

entries.zh: 我们都是同一个星系的公民。在我们的边界内，欢迎所有的星系公民。
entries.en: We are all citizens of the same galaxy. Everyone should feel welcome within our borders.

entries.zh: 我们不可以仰仗他人，必须专注于让自己变得更加强大。
entries.en: We cannot rely on others, and must focus on making ourselves stronger.

entries.zh: 我们的政治气候必须鼓励协商，尊重不同的观点。
entries.en: Our political climate must encourage compromises and respect for differing views.

entries.zh: 为了使我们的社会真正繁荣，人们必须尊重权威的判断。
entries.en: For us to truly prosper as a society, people must respect the judgment of the regime.

entries.zh: 我们定能在信仰中寻得安宁、决心与意义。
entries.en: In our faith we must find comfort, purpose and direction.

entries.zh: 满足我们对成长的渴望的唯一可行的方法就是制造它。
entries.en: The only practical way to satisfy our desire for growth is through manufacturing it.

entries.zh: 无数的印象和结论淹没了我们。学会过滤所有信息后留下最重要的声音需要花费一些精力，但这也能让我们提高效率。
entries.en: Millions of impressions and conclusions overwhelm us. Learning to filter out all but the most important voices takes effort, but also makes us more efficient.

entries.zh: 我们可以适应环境，但最终还是要做到让环境适应我们。
entries.en: We can adapt to our surroundings, but in the end nature will bend to our will.

entries.zh: 只有建立互信才能创造美好未来。
entries.en: Only through building trust can we create a better future.

entries.zh: 我们要不忘初心，探明星系中所有的秘密。
entries.en: We must fervently chart all the mysteries of the galaxy.

entries.zh: 暂时调整公民身份要求，提高了对我们边界内的人的期望。
entries.en: Citizenship requirements are temporarily adjusted, raising expectations of those within our borders.

entries.zh: 我们的正常子个体中有一个公认的反常度水平，因为有一些分歧可以提高生产力。
entries.en: There is an accepted deviancy level among our simple drones, as some divergences can result in raised productivity.

entries.zh: 我们可以舒适地利用[GetIndividualNamePlural]一定的反常度来允许生产方式创新的爆发。
entries.en: We can comfortably wield a degree of deviancy among our [GetIndividualNamePlural] in order to permit novel bursts of productivity.

entries.zh: 我们在后勤方面做了大量的努力，以支持新殖民地的发展。
entries.en: We make substantial logistical efforts to support the development of our new colonies.

entries.zh: 我们在后勤方面做了大量的努力，以支持驿站的发展。
entries.en: We make substantial logistical efforts to support the development of our waystations.

entries.zh: 由于内阁议程，该殖民地获得了发展方面的大力支援。
entries.en: This colony has substantial development support due to a Council Agenda.

entries.zh: 尽管我们的价值观不同，但共同的愿景让我们和谐共处。
entries.en: A shared vision brings us harmony despite our differing values.

entries.zh: 我们承诺在商业协议中为所有相关方实现利益最大化。
entries.en: We commit entirely to maximizing the benefits for all involved parties in our Commercial Pacts.

entries.zh: 我们承诺为我们的客户实现利益最大化。
entries.en: We are entirely committed to maximizing the benefits for all of our Clientele.

entries.zh: 分部地产产生的犯罪度
对于生活和工作在首都的公民，我们应该提供特殊的优待政策。
entries.en: We choose to provide special dispensation to citizens living and working on our Capital.

entries.zh: 我们选择聚焦更多能量和注意力到繁荣的首都上，这是核心中的核心。
entries.en: We choose to focus more energy and attention on our thriving capital, heart of all Hearts.

entries.zh: 我们通过底层重构优化了理事会。
entries.en: We streamline council departments by rebuilding them from the ground up.

entries.zh: [GetGestaltEntityName]和内阁官员节点可以暂时性互相强制实现高一级的效率。
entries.en: The [GetGestaltEntityName] and its Councilor Nodes can be forced into a temporary, heightened state of efficiency.

entries.zh: 我们可以暂时对最高优先级的处理节点进行超频，以提高效率。
entries.en: We can temporarily overclock our highest priority Processing Nodes, to gain efficiency.

entries.zh: 我们的效率前所未有地提高了。
entries.en: Our work is more efficient than ever.

entries.zh: 通过政治程序和优化官僚机构，我们能更好地操纵我们的对手。
entries.en: Through political procedure and streamlined bureaucracy, we are better suited to manipulate our rivals.

entries.zh: 必须热烈地讨论和追求关于改进我们自身的新方法的观念和理论。
entries.en: Ideas and theories for new ways to improve ourselves must be discussed and pursued with fervor.

entries.zh: 必须把关于改进我们自身的新方法的观念和理论放在第一位。
entries.en: Ideas and theories for new ways to improve ourselves must be prioritized.

entries.zh: 用于维护和运行我们单元的新流程和方法必须被放在第一位。
entries.en: New procedures and methods for maintaining and running our units must be prioritized.
An enduring pursuit of new insights.

entries.zh: 研究这些强势的威胁让我们可以在对抗发生之前调整军队。
entries.en: Studying these imposing threats will allow us to adapt our forces before a confrontation can arise.

entries.zh: 我们用尽办法收集所有人事物背后的信息。
entries.en: We pursue all means possible of gaining information on anyone and everything.

entries.zh: 果断行动，我们已经准备好应对任何威胁。
entries.en: By acting decisively, we stand prepared for any threats.

entries.zh: 如果领土受到威胁，我们将做好最坏的打算和准备。
entries.en: We will prepare for the worst and be ready, should our territory ever be threatened.

entries.zh: 提升恒星基地研究选项概率
entries.en: Increased chance of Starbase research options.

entries.zh: 趁你的敌人正在休养生息的时候发动攻击是一项历史悠久的[Owner.GetSpeciesName]传统。
entries.en: Attacking while your enemy is reeling remains a time-honored [Owner.GetSpeciesName] tradition.

entries.zh: 移除同宿敌的所有停战协议。
我们所有的领袖无论愿意与否都会花费可观的时间和精力进行内省和行为再培训。
entries.en: All our leaders spend, willingly or not, considerable time and effort on introspection and behavioral retraining.

entries.zh: 我们领袖所蕴含的独特而仁慈的方面被聚集和统一到我们更高的意识中来。
entries.en: All unique, and benevolent, aspects of our leaders are gathered and unified into our higher consciousness.

entries.zh: 我们领袖所具有的良性非标准流程都将被分析、过滤并最终整合进核心中。
entries.en: All optimal non-standard procedures from leader units are analyzed, filtered, and finally combined with our core.

entries.zh: §Y在所有低于§Y技能等级10§!的§Y领袖§!间共享$@agenda_leadership_conditioning_exp_reward|0$§!经验
entries.en: §Y$@agenda_leadership_conditioning_exp_reward|0$§! Experience will be shared between all §YLeaders§! below §YSkill Level 10§!

entries.zh: 适应产生的良性长期效应。
entries.en: A positive long term effect from the conditioning.

entries.zh: [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]将意识到并赞誉我们对他们的绝对允诺。
entries.en: The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] will recognize and praise our absolute commitment to them.

entries.zh: 我们必须激励我们的人民，让他们相信灵能将带领我们走向伟大的命运。
entries.en: We must inspire and assure our people of the great destiny our Psionic powers will lead us to.

entries.zh: 我们必须集中我们的精力让基因变得更加完美。
entries.en: We must focus our efforts to achieve absolute genetic perfection.

entries.zh: 我们必须确保我们边界内的每一个人都能得到最好的义体升级。
entries.en: We must ensure that our best Cybernetic enhancements are made available to everyone within our borders.

entries.zh: 我们必须确保我们边界内的每一个人都合理地分配和安装最好的义体升级。
entries.en: We must ensure that our best Cybernetic enhancements are distributed and installed properly among everyone within our borders.

entries.zh: 对我们的合成人的优越性的任何怀疑都必须被抛在一边。
entries.en: Any doubt regarding the superiority of our synthetics must be cast aside.

entries.zh: 允许环境适应协议的本地集群和补丁。
entries.en: Permit local clustering and patching of environmental adaptation protocols.

entries.zh: 必须优先协调[GetIndividualNamePlural]和殖民地的工作。
entries.en: Coordinating our [GetIndividualNamePlural] and colonies must be prioritized.

entries.zh: 必须优先考虑分析和对存在的理解。
entries.en: Analysis and existential understanding must be prioritized.

entries.zh: 必须优先考虑先发制人的措施。
必须优先考虑控制我们在宇宙中的领土边界。
entries.en: Controlling the boundaries of our territory in space must be prioritized.

entries.zh: 令人分散注意力的数据，以及错误的结论阻碍了我们的推理能力。我们必须清除所有多余的信息。
entries.en: Distracting data points, and false conclusions hinder our reasoning skills. We must purge all redundant information.

entries.zh: 移除统治者和内阁官员节点的§H负面特质§!。\n每移除一项特质，失去§R$@agenda_gestalt_purge_traits_exp_change|0$§!经验。
entries.en: Removes §HNegative Traits§! from Ruler and Councilor Nodes.\nFor each Trait removed, lose §R$@agenda_gestalt_purge_traits_exp_change|0$§! experience.

entries.en: Our $councilor_gestalt_growth$ is no longer suited for our purpose, it shall be culled and a replacement Node shall be grown.

entries.en: Our $councilor_gestalt_regulatory$ is no longer suited for our purpose, it shall be reformatted and restored to the last valid backup.

entries.zh: 随着星海舞台的风云变幻，我们的运筹本能也应如此。任何不再具有优势的进化位阶将被剔除。
entries.en: As the galactic stage evolves, so too should our operational instincts. Any evolutionary niche that no longer gives an advantage will be culled.

entries.zh: 移除之后，会有一个替换性节点将被鼓励在合适的环境中成长起来。诀窍就是用前一个节点来滋养它。
entries.en: Once removed, a replacement node is encouraged to grow within the proper environment. The secret is to feed it the previous node.

entries.zh: 踢出整个节点非常没有效率。相反，只需要修剪一些不需要的枝叶就行。
entries.en: Culling an entire node is very inefficient. Instead, just trim the divergent and unwanted lobes.

entries.zh: §Y剔除议程§!可以将不再适合我们目的的节点替换掉。这将把一个我们目前的节点替换成一个等级较低的节点。
entries.en: §YCulling Agendas§! allow us to replace Nodes that are no longer suited for our purpose. They will replace one of our current Nodes with a lower level Node.

entries.zh: 在快速发展的星系舞台，自决协议和制导算法可能会过时。它们将被像其他垃圾数据一样被覆盖掉。
entries.en: Self-determination protocols and guidance algorithms can become obsolete in a rapidly developing galactic stage. Like any junk data, they shall be overwritten.

entries.zh: 每个自迭代算法都有它的价值。我们不会让重要的学识白白浪费在恢复我们的领袖身上。
entries.en: Every self-iterating algorithm has its value. We will not allow important learning go to waste when restoring our leaders.

entries.zh: 使用一个失败的软件来开发它的继任者可以快速重建。从错误的记忆路径中学习可以产生更高级的内阁指令。
entries.en: Using a failed piece of software to develop its successor enables quick reconstruction. Learning from faulty memory pathways generates even more advanced council directives.

entries.zh: §Y格式化议程§!可以将不再适合我们目的的节点替换掉。这将把一个我们目前的节点替换成一个等级较低的节点。
entries.en: §YReformatting Agendas§! allow us to replace Nodes that are no longer suited for our purpose. They will replace one of our current Nodes with a lower level Node.
